findings.title: Companionship also leaves an attached residue
findings.claim: While أصحاب ordinarily names companionship with fire, the supplied outlier lets that carrier analogically image an incriminating residue that remains attached to the wrongdoer after the act, with remorse as its immediate trace.
findings.mechanism: The focus companionship carrier is paired with the supplied attached-hide image and with 5:31's remorse after concealment; attachment therefore colors the consequence without changing the ordinary group relation.
findings.reader_payoff: Fire-companionship becomes perceptible not only as an external group relation but also, exploratorily, as consequence that clings to the actor after the killing.
findings.containment: This is branch-distant and analogical. It must remain an attached-residue image alongside, never a lexical replacement for, the ordinary companionship reading; the HFT source is legacy_unbound and exploratory.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and 5:31 remorse contact are exact and the packet explicitly bounds the outlier as an analogy, but the material adhesion image is branch-distant and supplied by a legacy_unbound HFT trace.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:31 names remorse after the completed killing and concealment.
branch_activations.activation: The attached-material image meets the lingering remorse trace through the focus companionship carrier.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Companionship can be analogically felt as an incriminating consequence remaining attached to its bearer.
branch_activations.boundary: The material branch is used only as an analogy of clinging residue, not as the lexical meaning of أصحاب in the focus.

branch_activations.boundary: The HFT branch is unresolved and the residue image remains attributed and analogical.
